summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — A major refactor of the IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector introduces FCC-SEED as an option across detectors, updates vertex/silicon-wrapper pitches, adds a new `CLD_o5_v01` variant, and fixes the CLD disk material budget as `CLD_o1_v09` ([#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612)). The ALLEGRO HCAL Endcap pseudo-layer position calculation was fixed for PandoraPFA compatibility ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)), and the `dd4hep2root` conversion utility now maps volumes to the closest predefined ROOT colours ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)) with a follow-up bug fix for its colour caching ([#667](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/667)).
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — ALLEGRO configurations gain TRAPPIST-based particle identification for both topocluster and (with FIXME caveats) sliding-window clusters in `o1_v03` and `o2_v01` ([#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392)); STT hits are now included in the track finder with a fix for the perfect track fitter ([#396](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/396)) and the STT digitizer is wired into `ALLEGRO_o2_v01` reconstruction via the `isSTT` property ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388)). Vertex and silicon wrapper resolutions were updated to 3 µm spatial / 5 ns timing and 50 µm/√12 respectively ([#384](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/384)), a k4run crash from the `DCHdigi_v02` → `WireTrackerDigi_v01` rename was patched ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)), and updated IDEA Delphes/EDM4hep cards plus refreshed ZH/ZZ/WW Pythia8 generator cards were added ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)).
- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter)** — Adds a full "seeded" ECAL clustering chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter, comprising `CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`, `TrackDrivenClusterSeeding`, `ClusterSeedMerging`, `ClusterSeedGrower`, and a new `CreateOpticalCaloCells` converter with truth-link matching (including a `maskCherenkovForTruthLink` option), plus a CI test for the IDEA o2 reco chain ([#271](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/271)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — Renames `DCHdigi_v02` to `WireTrackerDigi_v01`, making it usable for both drift chambers and straw-tube trackers via a new `isSTT` Gaudi property (which repurposes `nphi` as `tube` and populates `sector` in the cellID); the old name is retained as an alias for backward compatibility ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100), [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/103)).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The EDM4hep reader now defaults the primary vertex to the end vertex of a parent-less particle (or (0,0,0) if absent), matching HepMC3EventReader behaviour and enabling consistent Pythia→ddsim results across intermediate formats ([#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684)). Additionally, the CSG-based CAD exporter in DDCAD was removed since ROOT made RCsg private, with a replacement implementation intended to follow ([#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)).
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — Adds Gaudi 41 `EventContext` support in the DataHandle API, allowing algorithms to pass an `EventContext` on `createAndPut()` while preserving the older empty-argument form ([#432](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/432)). The `OverlayTiming` component was simplified by replacing per-frame index maps with direct offset arithmetic, incidentally fixing a bug where daughters with empty parent lists were silently dropped ([#429](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/429)). `k4run` now accepts `--evt-max` as an alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax` ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Replaces the in-house EDM4hep track conversion with the centralised `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil` (`writeTrack`/`writeTrackState`) and fixes the track state covariance layout to follow `edm4hep::TrackParams` ordering, ensuring downstream consumers read correct elements ([#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95)). Also adds a GNN pipeline `ClassifiedEdgePrinting` pass-through stage for debugging ([#105](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/105)), an edge sorting/flipping option to match the acorn training convention ([#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103)), and support for the renamed ACTS `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct ([#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104)).
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, which was selecting the wrong overload in Python bindings ([#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Stores photon direction and pointing resolution in `ITheta`/`IPhi` with `directionError`, and computes hit position error into `positionError` for `errorPhi`/`errorTheta`, requiring Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02 ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)).
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Shrinks children volumes overlapping their parents to eliminate rendering artefacts (visible on IDEA o1 v01), reduces the `numFaces` build option to 1000, raises transparency to 100%, and fixes a missing-field bug in `concatenateOutput.ts` ([#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15)).
